correctness.rationale: Explicit definitions and exact independent Gaussian projection establish radial normalization. Third cumulant of edge absolute differences has only single, adjacent-pair and connected-three-edge support; path/star/triangle integrals follow Nabeya (1952). Independent graph atlas comparisons (141 connected graphs, 3–6 vertices) match a direct trivariate calculation. Regularity makes every motif count except triangles fixed. A rational strict-negative certificate for the universal coefficient rules out numerical-sign artifacts. Enumeration is corroboration only.
